Sandbox_TienDualwield_SwapHands_tooltip: A key (set in Key Bindings, under Dual Wield) swaps the items in your two hands, for example to reload the other handgun.
Sandbox_TienDualwield_OffhandAttack_tool: With a one-handed weapon in each hand, holding the off-hand modifier key while attacking swings the weapon in the off hand (left hand) instead.
Sandbox_TienDualwield_BothAttack_tooltip: With a one-handed melee weapon in each hand, a key swings both weapons at once.
Sandbox_TienDualwield_DualHandguns_toolt: With a handgun in each hand, every shot fires both guns. The off-hand gun never fires alone, and reloading always reloads the gun in your main hand: swap hands to reload the other one.
